WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT id, name, parent_id, leader_username, leader_real_name FROM sys_department WHERE id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.parent_id, d.leader_username, d.leader_real_name FROM sys_department d INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.parent_id = dt.id WHERE d.deleted = 0 ) SELECT dt.id AS deptId, dt.name AS deptName, dt.leader_username AS leaderUsername, dt.leader_real_name AS leaderRealName, u.id AS userId, u.real_name AS userRealName FROM dept_tree dt LEFT JOIN sys_user_department ud ON dt.id = ud.department_id AND ud.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ud.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.enabled = 1 ORDER BY dt.id, u.id
